question: Which of the following countries launched the 'Atal Innovation Mission-Sirius Innovation Programme 3.0' in November 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__India and Russia.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** "AIM-Sirius Innovation Programme3.0"** has been **jointly launched** by the** Atal Innovation Mission (AIM),** a key project of the** NITI Aayog**, and **Sirius (Scientific International Research In Unique Terrestrial Station)**, a Russian station.
 
• **AIM-Sirius Innovation Programme 3.0** is a **14-day online curriculum** for students in **India and Russia.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• In the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic, approximately **48 students, 16 educators, and 8 mentors **developed **8 virtual products and mobile applications during the event.**
 
• These fields include **chemistry, artificial intelligence, digital financial assets, applied cognitive science, culture, remote learning, health and wellbeing, sports, fitness, and gaming training.**
